goal: Implement Omni-Channel Cross-Device Auto Trader Active Position Synchronization, Supabase UUID Sanitization, and Remote Market Execution

contracts.interfaces: export interface AutoTraderPositionState { symbol: string; pair: string; entryPrice: number; currentPrice: number; highestSeen: number; units: number; capitalInvested: number; stopLossPrice: number; takeProfitPrice: number; breakEvenArmed: boolean; breakEvenPrice: number; trailingArmed: boolean; trailingStopPrice: number; mfePct: number; maePct: number; unrealizedPnlUsd: number; unrealizedPnlPct: number; holdingSeconds: number; orderId?: string; entryTimestampMs: number; }
function_signatures: subscribeToAutoTraderSession(userId: string, callback: (session: AutoTraderSessionRow) => void): () => void

execution_steps: Write unit tests in frontend/src/__tests__/cross_device_autotrader_sync.test.js covering UUID sanitization, active position normalization, and remote market execution
Run node --test frontend/src/__tests__/cross_device_autotrader_sync.test.js to observe test failures before implementation
Sanitize UUID v4 generation and foreign key handling for bot_trades in frontend/src/lib/supabase.ts
Implement normalizeActivePosition and auto-healing synchronization from local storage to Supabase in frontend/src/contexts/AutoTraderContext.tsx
Update exitActivePosition in frontend/src/contexts/AutoTraderContext.tsx to allow remote market execution when runnerRef.current is absent
Ensure AssetsView.tsx displays active token metadata and current spot valuations when a position is present
Run node --test frontend/src/__tests__/cross_device_autotrader_sync.test.js to verify test suite passes
acceptance_criteria: persistTradeToSupabase replaces non-UUID identifiers with valid UUID v4 strings and sets bot_id to null when referencing non-grid bots
normalizeActivePosition transforms both camelCase and snake_case properties into unified position state
Active position transitions trigger upsertAutoTraderSessionInSupabase with status IN_POSITION and serialized position state
Position closures update Supabase auto_trader_sessions to status SCANNING with null active_position
exitActivePosition succeeds on secondary screens where runnerRef.current is null
Unit tests in cross_device_autotrader_sync.test.js execute with code 0
Frontend build completes without TypeScript compilation errors
